design.authority: One active CODEX_HOME/auth.json, transferred during stopped execution-mode transactions; independent writable homes remain.
design.activation: First actual mode change; granting ROOT without selecting it does not initialize shared auth. Current mode wins, including no-login/logout.
design.legacy: Inactive auth is renamed once to root:root0700 state/shared-chatgpt-auth/legacy-<mode>.auth.json0600; never automatically restored.
design.lifecycle: In-place refresh and unlink logout stay native. Latest data/inode/mtime or absence moves; compensation does not restore stale tokens.
design.recovery: Root-private mode/transaction/inode journal, descriptor-relative renameat2 NOREPLACE, fsync and ownership transfer. Old recovery directly restores the old home without requiring publication into a broken candidate home.
design.control: sharedChatgptAuth=1 capability; once shared state exists, incompatible control selection/rollback/recovery is denied before stop.
design.storage: Managed app-server/catalog-server rejects explicit non-file root/profile configuration and then pins -c file. No keyring read or automatic conversion. Manager mutation preflight checks before receipt/stop. Unmanaged local runtime unchanged.
design.budgets: 4MiB existing generated-layer budget for system config/requirements and namespace views;1MiB user/host-managed/project TOML.
